title: Chop downed log
notes: Create a complete appropriate workstation and tools for this occupational action, retain exact character identity. Physically plausible two-handed action. Fixed station across all frames. Full character AND entire workstation visible in EVERY cell, tools completely inside frame. Reduce figure size to fit generous empty transparent borders, especially above raised tools. Exactly eight sequential images in 4 columns 2 rows, each action a coherent cycle.
prompt: Local in-place edit of exact transparent 4 columns x2rows eight-pose sheet. All 8 chopping stumps and spare wood pieces must remain pixel-aligned with exact ORIGINAL silhouettes, grain pattern, feet and frame dimensions. Do not redraw the stump: preserve exact bark ridges and lower foreground scraps. Only the log on TOP of the stump in the LAST bottom-right pose changes. This last log must remain TWO SEPARATE SPLIT HALVES matching bottom-third pose. Preserve two halves' cut faces and gap; no whole log may regenerate. Axe recovers low just above the gap, still held in both hands. Never alter any of the other seven cells. Same canonical red-haired dwarf body, leather vest, green trousers, brown boots, axe design, light, camera, scale. Transparent background. All fixed furniture, stump core and side fragments unchanged.
